17.label: The Vanishing of Endres
17.desc: Endres has not come to the bench in four days. The master scrivener says nothing, which is how he says things. Endres lodged in the Warrens; you know the door. (The Warrens) The Bishop asks mercy for whoever did this, if they repent: a Pardon or a Fine, not the rope.

c16.title: The Vanishing of Endres

vars.detail: the door was locked from outside

suspects.name: Tom Seiler
suspects.motive: Endres copied a bond he was told not to read, and read it.

suspects.name: Pieter Haller
suspects.role: the man whose bond it was
suspects.motive: A deed in the Warrens, and a name on it that should not be there.

suspects.name: Lienhard Fuller
suspects.motive: Owed Endres a month's rent and a great deal of silence.

items.label: A Curved Scratch
items.text: A fresh curved scratch in the wax of the table, the kind a heavy signet leaves on a clenched fist.

items.label: The Last Evening
items.text: the door was locked from outside. Whatever happened, it happened fast.

result.label: The Cipher Broken
result.text: Read out, the last leaves speak of being followed, and name the person they feared in everything but name.

items.label: Left Behind: an unsent letter
items.text: an unsent letter, on the kitchen table, where they would see it every morning.

witnesses: the tapster at the corner alehouse

journal.title: A Notice: The Vanishing of Endres
journal.text: Endres has not come to the bench in four days. The master scrivener says nothing, which is how he says things. Endres lodged in the Warrens; you know the door. Nobody else is going to look.

journal.title: The Day-book
journal.text: Forty people come to the desk. Thirty-nine of them are nothing.

journal.title: A Day's Labour
journal.text: A Coin, honestly earned, and your back knows it.

journal.title: Before the Office
journal.text: Six years you copied the last Examiner's day-book, and when he died the desk went to nobody and the copying went to you, at a rented bench over the scriveners' shop. You know every form, fee and seal in the city, and have never once been in a fight. No office, no stipend, no name the crier would sing. Health in Attend earns a Coin; so does Wit, more slowly. The city has not noticed you yet.

spec.label: Letter: Beadle
spec.desc: A parish beadle with a staff and a loud voice. Knocks on doors without complaining and whips beggars without being asked. Costs 1 Coin.

intro.hint: Somebody you know is missing, and you are already at the door. When Explore is done, open it: tap a card to turn it over, double-tap to take it.
